What I do

End-to-end 3D visualization and data services for startups, studios, brands and educators.

✦

3D Product Modeling

Concept-to-render modeling, texturing and lighting for product visualization and marketing assets.

Deliverables: modeled source files, UVs, textured renders
♢

Jewelry CAD for 3D Printing

Custom ring and jewelry designs ready for printing in silver, gold or platinum — from simple to complex filigree.

Deliverables: CAD files, print-ready geometry, renders

Photorealistic Rendering

High-resolution renders with realistic materials, lighting and camera setup for catalogs and campaigns.

3D Animation

Turnaround animations, product spins and short visual stories for social and ecommerce.

Deliverables: animated sequences, still frames
▢

Data Annotation

Image and video annotation with multi-stage QA for ML and computer-vision teams.

Deliverables: labeled datasets, QA reports
